The Role of Markets and Money appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

The OCR board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with The Role of Markets and Money.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
